calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  w.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(w.web_order_id) as order_count,
  SUM(w.order_total_gross) as total_sales
FROM fact_web_order w
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(w.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    w.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(w.order_total_gross) as sales
  FROM fact_web_order w
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(w.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_period,
    SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM period_sales
  GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  ps.fiscal_period as period,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ps.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN ps.sales ELSE 0 END) / pt.total_sales, 2) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM period_sales ps
INNER JOIN period_totals pt ON ps.fiscal_year = pt.fiscal_year AND ps.fiscal_period = pt.fiscal_period
GROUP BY ps.fiscal_period, pt.total_sales
ORDER BY ps.fiscal_period
